intent: Designed a balanced 5-sensor array with moderate sensor size and stable chassis dimensions to improve line detection and control signal quality, aiming to reduce line loss and improve race completion and progress.
rationale: Starting with a balanced and robust sensor layout to maximize line detection and control signal quality. Chose 5 sensors spaced evenly across the front of the robot to cover the tape width well, with a sensor size of 0.012 m to balance resolution and coverage. Set wheel track to 0.14 m for stability and maneuverability, wheel radius to 0.035 m for a good speed-torque tradeoff, and body dimensions moderate to avoid off-track penalties while allowing room for sensors. Mass set to 0.8 kg as a moderate value to balance inertia and responsiveness. Intent is to provide the integrator a stable, well-sensed platform to develop a controller that can follow the line accurately and quickly. Expect improved line detection and reduced line loss events, leading to better progress and completion rates.
